targets.self_route_adjudication: CONFIRMED -- NON_CONTRIBUTORY / starved. The load-bearing precondition dense_pair_matched_competent = FALSE (min(majority_supra_floor(z_world_dense), majority_supra_floor(raw_dense)) = 0, threshold 1): neither dense arm cleared the 1.0 forage floor (z_world_dense 0.217 0/3; raw_dense 0.767 1/3). So the decisive INV-088 representation-vs-diversity contrast (748 vs 749 at matched competence) cannot be read. TWO nested causes: (1) design -- 750's 'dense' arms are dense-reward-SHAPING RL (shaping_coef=1.0), the SUB-FLOOR variant already shown starved in 748/749; the arms that actually cleared the floor there were BC (behavior cloning), which 750 did not use, so the precondition was doomed by construction; (2) deeper -- even the BC arms would NOT give a clean read: a behavior-cloned policy's action distribution reflects the imitated EXPERT's diversity, not the representation's intrinsic diversity-affording capacity (both z_world+BC and raw+BC clone the same expert), so the teacher launders INV-088's contrast. A clean representation->diversity read at matched competence requires matched-competent UNSUPERVISED policies on BOTH representations -> the same explorer build 751 motivates (plus the raw-view explorer arm 751 did not run). The instrument itself works (H_greedy calibration random_walk 2.32 - constant 0.0 = 2.32 bits > 1.0).

Design pitfall recorded: 750's 'dense' arms are dense-reward-SHAPING RL (shaping_coef=1.0), the sub-floor variant already starved in 748/749 -- NOT the BC variant that cleared the floor. The 2x2 label 'dense teacher = PASS' conflated BC (the arm that passed) with shaping (the arm that failed).

Deeper design constraint: even BC arms would not give a clean representation->diversity read -- BC launders the representation's diversity contribution through the imitated expert. The clean read requires matched-competent UNSUPERVISED policies on both representations.

Therefore 750's retest blocks on the SAME mech457_unsupervised_novelty_explorer build (751 target), extended to reach matched competence on BOTH z_world and raw 5x5 view (751 ran z_world explorer arms only).

Confound flag (NOT evidence against INV-088): at sub-floor competence z_world arms collapse to near-monostrategy (direction opposite to INV-088's prediction) -- a training-collapse artifact that vindicates the matched-competence gate.
